$GameCube and Classic Controller
*By quatric
*Meet the Robinsons (Europe, Fr/It) (RRSX4Q)
*Play with a GameCube controller (any port) or a Classic Controller instead of a Wii Remote and Nunchuk.
*Stick moves, C-stick / right stick is the pointer. No Wii Remote is needed for the GameCube controller.
* KPADiRead entry: poll the GameCube ports through the Serial Interface
